usehelios.ai: 75. The gap: the sitemap host.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 31 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

Lesson: Serve sitemap.xml from the same host as the pages it lists, and name it in robots.txt.

ruvo.com: 79. The gap: the CSP.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But no content security policy.

Lesson: Tighten the content security policy one directive at a time, starting from default-src 'self'.

mono.la: 81. The gap: framing.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.

Lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.

Lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
